about_short_description.short_description: TENEX.AI is a cybersecurity company that combines human expertise with artificial intelligence to protect digital assets.

product.name: Managed Detection and Response (MDR)
product.description: A service combining AI-driven threat detection with automated response to identify, contain, and neutralize cybersecurity threats continuously.

product.name: Threat Management
product.description: A service that identifies system vulnerabilities, monitors emerging threats, and implements strategic defenses to protect business operations.

product.name: Incident Response
product.description: A service providing rapid containment and resolution of cybersecurity breaches to minimize downtime and protect data.

product.name: Security Automation
product.description: A service that automates security workflows across numerous tools to streamline detection, response, and mitigation processes.

product.name: Core Security Platform
product.description: A platform service that implements, operates, and manages the Google Cloud Security stack without continuous monitoring.

product.name: Advanced Oversight
product.description: An enhanced monitoring service adding proactive threat detection, hunting, and review without full MDR commitment.
